scope: Staged credential document admission, independent of the legacy production storage implementation

paired.comparison: Admission outcomes, admitted payloads and schema diagnostics compare exactly. Syntax diagnostics retain each parser code/position in separate raw files and compare the stable invalid-document prefix and rejection, with their runtime-specific middle normalized.

verification.native: 15 pure-parser and existing provider regression cases passed
verification.source: 36 fixed Source record, migration and review-fix tests passed
verification.scope_reason: The changed module is not yet registered in production. Its actual fixed-Source corpus covers references, record fields, null versus absence, core/legacy scalar admission, unknown top-level keys, explicit scalar tags, numeric rounding, duplicates, alias identity/cycles and the original-inclusive alias resource budget. Unit cases inspect actual traceback redaction and isolation from PyYAML global resolvers.

behavior: Unknown top-level keys resolve nothing and are returned by name. References and records remain strict; a present null API key/env differs from an absent field.

Default core YAML scalars preserve yes/on/date strings and parse numeric values with the Source Number domain. Explicit YAML 1.1 scalar resolution is supported without changing other PyYAML consumers.
Conversion follows YAML nodes and alias identities, with destination snapshots established before nested aliases and the pinned alias cost/count limit checked even for ignored foreign data.
Invalid scalar tag resolution follows Source fallback to a string or a safe tag failure; timestamps and binary values are refused as grant payloads that JSON cannot represent.
YAML parser failures quote only a code and optional location. Neither parser exception text nor source excerpts escape through the Native exception chain.
diagnostics: Initial comparisons exposed runtime-specific YAML syntax diagnostics, which are retained separately rather than relabelled as identical.

Added explicit-tag cases exposed default constructor value leaks and tag-admission differences. Scalars now follow the matching core pattern before conversion; invalid timestamp tags produce safe diagnostics.
The duplicate/alias conversion uses composed nodes instead of PyYAML object construction so Source anchor order, replacement, cycles and resource accounting can be compared directly.
limits: The production provider still uses its previous parser until the storage/editor contract is ready. Activation must include preservation of foreign entries, atomic edits, failed reload retention, and watcher/disposal ownership.

This corpus does not certify every YAML feature: collection tags such as set/omap/pairs, legacy merge resolution, complex collection-key formatting and all parser recovery diagnostics remain to inspect before claiming complete document parity.
Targeted checks do not establish full migration or Portable/browser/Win7 release acceptance.
retained: Raw paired results, both parser diagnostics, commands/logs and XML; no remaining synthetic parser workspace. Source/toolchains retained for C9.
